data.title: Local Professional Qualifying Rounds Conclude with Fierce Competition at King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The local professional qualifying rounds at the 2026 King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival, organized by the National Center for Falcons in Malham, north of Riyadh, and running until November 30, have concluded with fierce competition and closely matched performances across juvenile and adult classes for Pure Gyr, Peregrine, Saker, and Gyr hybrid falcons.
Standout qualifiers included falconer Falah Al-Humaidani, who secured first and third places in the juvenile Pure Gyr round, and Mohammed Al-Subaie, who won first place in both the adult Pure Gyr and adult Gyr hybrid categories.
Alongside long-time participant Raad Al-Harbi, the falconers attributed the heightened competitiveness to rigorous preparation and praised the organizing committees' continuous improvements in competition management, which continue to elevate the festival's international standing.
-- SPA
